chapter_title_en: Stirring the Seas Beyond; Giant Beast Attacks
chapter_seo_title: Netherworld Domain Revealed: Mana-Sealed Village Under Beast Siege – RMJI Ch.590
chapter_meta_description: Han Li and Mei Ning arrive in the Netherworld Domain, where mana is useless. Welcomed by former cultivators, they face a giant Jiaozheng beast attack. A pivotal worldbuilding chapter.
og_title: A Mortal’s Journey: The Village in the Netherworld
og_description: Mana fails, netherworld force rises. Han Li witnesses a coordinated defense against a four-eyed giant ape.
twitter_title: Netherworld Domain is no joke—giant beasts, purple mist formations, and no mana allowed. RMJI Ch.590 drops new world rules.
twitter_description: Han Li lands in a mana-sealed realm, befriends former cultivators, and watches a giant winged ape get wrecked by purple mist tentacles.

lore_anchors.definition: The eerie realm into which victims are pulled by ghost mists; mana is sealed here, and only netherworld force can be used.
A yin-aligned energy that replaces mana in the Netherworld Domain; cannot fuel spells but can power arrays made from beast crystals.
A supernatural fog that drags ships and cultivators into the Netherworld Domain; a classic danger in the Chaotic Star Sea.
A giant, four-eyed, winged ape-like monster from the Netherworld Domain, highly aggressive and physically powerful; a major threat to walled villages.
A core harvested from yin beasts, capable of powering small formations in the Netherworld Domain.
The village's defensive array, manifested as a purple mist that absorbs lightning and can form tentacles to immobilize attackers.

The second major cultivation realm, granting a cultivator a stable internal foundation and a lifespan of approximately 200 years; a former Foundation Establishment cultivator is a valuable asset even in a mana-sealed world.
